draft.emotion: warm and familiar, speaking of a child running outside
notes: Do not confuse with the inflected adjective 'jonge' ('young'), which has no final -n in spelling.
In the plural, 'jongens!' is very commonly used to address any group of people informally ('guys!'), regardless of gender.
